title: Linear-Quadratic Mean Field Games with Hybrid Local-Global Interactions on Manifolds
summary: This paper studies linear-quadratic mean field games on compact Riemannian manifolds with a hybrid interaction topology. The network structure is a superposition of a deterministic graph for local geometric connectivity and a stochastic directed graph for non-local interactions. The global graph is constructed via random sampling based on a continuous kernel $K$. The out-degree of each node scales as $Θ(\log N)$ or as $Θ(N)$ to represent a sparse or dense network, respectively.
